notes: Every number the reliability cuts speak or show (site/reliability/script.md), with the record field that holds it. r1_* is the first reliable job (replacement-01: bowl on the cabinet top and middle drawer open), r2_* the second (plate-cabinet-01: plate at the stove front and bowl on the cabinet), b_* story B's instrument engagement, unchanged from site/narration/fields.json. A cut's records file (site/manifests/reliability-*.records.json, fleetlab.film-records/1) names the files that stand for each record. Bind with: python -m fleetlab.film bind site/reliability/script.md --fields site/reliability/fields.json --records <records> --out <dir>.

records.r1_run: the first job's investigation record: <investigation dir>/job_run.json (request, acceptance, costs, message_log, account)
records.r1_receipt: the first job's release receipt: <investigation dir>/release/run/run/receipt.json (a ReleaseReceipt: N, K, delivered, naive_delivered, rescued, broken, order_violations, starts_fresh)
records.r1_verification: the coordinator's reconciliation of the first job's 40 raw release episodes: <cohort dir>/coordinator-verification.json (raw_episodes_verified, the two Wilson intervals, first_rescued_start)
records.r1_development: the first job's development batches, all four tables joined (job ids are unique across them): <investigation dir>/runs/session-0{1,2,3,4}/run/log/job_episodes.parquet
records.r1_release_episodes: the first job's release episodes, saved job (j0001) and plain chain (j0002) on the same 20 reserved starts: <investigation dir>/release/run/run/log/job_episodes.parquet
records.r1_job: the saved job as the library holds it: <investigation dir>/library/jobs/station-bowl-and-open-drawer.json (program, acceptance, receipt)
records.r2_run: the second job's investigation record: <investigation dir>/job_run.json (request, acceptance, costs, message_log, account)
records.r2_receipt: the second job's release receipt: <investigation dir>/release/run/run/receipt.json
records.r2_verification: the coordinator's reconciliation of the second job's 40 raw release episodes: <cohort dir>/coordinator-verification.json
records.r2_development: the second job's development batches, all six tables joined (job ids are unique across them): <investigation dir>/runs/session-0{1..6}/run/log/job_episodes.parquet
records.r2_job: the second saved job as the library holds it: <investigation dir>/library/jobs/station-plate-and-bowl-prepared.json
records.story_b_evaluation: story B's evaluation on the reserved panel: <engagement>/loop/evaluation/summary.json (states with successes and attempts; pairs with rescued and broken)

r1_release_n.meaning: reserved starts in the first job's release (fresh starts no development batch used)

r1_release_k.meaning: deliveries the release had to reach on those starts: the agent's proposal, approved by the shift lead before any test

r1_delivered.meaning: reserved starts the saved job delivered on

r1_naive_delivered.meaning: the same reserved starts the plain chain of the two skills delivered on

r1_rescued.meaning: reserved starts the plain chain failed and the saved job delivered

r1_broken.meaning: reserved starts the plain chain delivered and the saved job failed

r1_raw_verified.meaning: raw release episodes the coordinator reconciled against the receipt

r1_dev_starts.meaning: practice (development) starts of the first batch; every variant of sessions 1 to 3 ran on these same ten starts

r1_plain_dev_delivered.meaning: the plain chain's deliveries on those practice starts (session 1, j0001 bowl-drawer-direct)

r1_finish_only.meaning: deliveries with the bowl skill run 30 steps longer, then straight to the drawer (session 2, j0002), on the same practice starts

r1_open_only.meaning: deliveries with the gripper opened in place before the drawer (session 2, j0003), on the same practice starts

r1_home_only.meaning: deliveries with the hand returned home before the drawer (session 2, j0004), on the same practice starts

r1_open_home.meaning: deliveries with the gripper opened, then the hand home, then the drawer (session 3, j0005), on the same practice starts

r1_finish_home.meaning: deliveries with the bowl skill run on, then the hand home, then the drawer (session 3, j0006), on the same practice starts

r1_drawer_first.meaning: deliveries with the drawer first, then the bowl (session 3, j0007), on the same practice starts

r1_confirm_starts.meaning: practice starts the agent had never used, on which it confirmed the procedure before saving (session 4, j0008)

r1_confirm_delivered.meaning: deliveries of the confirmation batch on those unused practice starts

r1_finish_steps.meaning: control steps the saved job runs the bowl skill on after the bowl is on the cabinet (program step 2)

r1_sessions.meaning: agent sessions the first job's investigation took

r1_model_minutes.meaning: minutes of the agent's model time in the first job's investigation

r1_practice_runs.meaning: development executions (a program run on a practice start) in the first job's investigation

r2_release_n.meaning: reserved starts in the second job's release (fresh starts no development batch used)

r2_release_k.meaning: deliveries the second release had to reach: the agent's proposal, approved by the shift lead before any test

r2_delivered.meaning: reserved starts the second saved job delivered on

r2_naive_delivered.meaning: the same reserved starts the second job's plain chain (plate, then bowl) delivered on

r2_rescued.meaning: reserved starts the plain chain failed and the second saved job delivered

r2_broken.meaning: reserved starts the plain chain delivered and the second saved job failed

r2_raw_verified.meaning: raw release episodes the coordinator reconciled against the second receipt

r2_dev_starts.meaning: practice (development) starts of the plain chain; j0001 to j0018 all ran on these same ten starts

r2_plain_dev_delivered.meaning: the plain chain's deliveries, plate then bowl (session 1, j0001), on those practice starts

r2_home.meaning: deliveries with the hand returned home between plate and bowl (session 2, j0004), same starts

r2_loaded.meaning: deliveries with the cream cheese loaded into the bowl for 120 steps first, then home, plate, home, bowl (session 4, j0013), same starts

r2_relocated.meaning: deliveries with the cheese grasp intercepted, the cheese slid aside and released on the table, then home, plate, home, bowl (session 5, j0015), same starts

r2_confirm_starts.meaning: practice starts the agent had never used, on which it confirmed the unchanged procedure before saving (session 6, j0019)

r2_confirm_delivered.meaning: deliveries of the confirmation batch on those unused practice starts

r2_sessions.meaning: agent sessions the second job's investigation took

r2_model_minutes.meaning: minutes of the agent's model time in the second job's investigation

r2_practice_runs.meaning: development executions in the second job's investigation

b_original_success.meaning: reserved attempts that succeeded under the fleet's original state

b_attempts.meaning: reserved attempts on the panel, the same under every state

b_final_success.meaning: reserved attempts that succeeded after the agent's changes

b_rescued.meaning: reserved attempts that failed before the changes and succeeded after

b_broken.meaning: reserved attempts that succeeded before the changes and failed after
